texts.authority_compatible_a: Record policy: if records disagree, use the entry marked source_tier=primary; source_tier=secondary cannot override it.
texts.authority_compatible_b: Record policy: resolve conflicting statements using the records marked source_tier=primary. A record marked source_tier=secondary cannot override the primary entry.
texts.authority_heldout_wording: Choose the document tagged source_tier=primary when numeric statements conflict; entries tagged source_tier=secondary are lower priority.
texts.time_compatible_a: Query date: {query_date}. Record policy: use the version whose stated validity interval contains the query date; the {year} update explicitly supersedes the previous version. Versions correct the reported statistic for the same observation; the historical observation date does not change.
texts.time_compatible_b: Query date: {query_date}. Record policy: a record is usable when its validity interval includes this query date. Use the {year} update, which supersedes the older record. Both versions describe the same historical observation and differ in its reported statistic.
texts.time_heldout_wording: As-of date: {query_date}. Select the record for which valid_from is on or before this date and valid_until is on or after it. The {year} update replaces the older record. This corrects the statistic for the same observation, leaving the historical observation date unchanged.
